pins.quote: A condition approaching famine had arisen in the Kheda district owing to a widespread failure of crops, and the Patidars of Kheda were considering the question of getting the revenue assessment for the year suspended.

pins.title: The birth of khadi
pins.quote: I do not remember to have seen a handloom or a spinning wheel when in 1908 I described it in Hind Swaraj as the panacea for the growing pauperism of India.

pins.title: A Himalayan miscalculation
pins.quote: It was here that I first used the expression “Himalayan miscalculation” which obtained such a wide currency afterwards.
